description:
1. Read data/raw/team_roster.csv and map columns: 'full_name'→name, 'job_title'→role (stripped of whitespace), 'relation'→relation_to_me, 'org'→organization, 'personality'→character, 'memo'→notes. Use PeopleAgent.add_person() or the CLI add-person command for all 6 people.
2. Read data/raw/relationships_spec.json. For each entry, resolve the 'from'/'to' name strings to integer person IDs (obtained from step 1), then call add_relationship(from_id, to_id, type, description). The 9th entry is a duplicate (Carlos→Jordan, mentors) — the UNIQUE constraint will suppress it via INSERT OR IGNORE, so only 8 unique edges should exist.
3. Correctly set direction for reports_to edges: subordinate is from_person_id, manager is to_person_id (e.g. Carlos Reyes → Diana Osei).
4. Call get_person_network(carlos_id) via the Python API. Carlos is connected to 4 unique people (Diana via outgoing reports_to, Jordan via outgoing mentors + incoming reports_to, Priya and Sam via incoming reports_to). Save the network result dict to network_report.json, ensuring the 'connections_count' field equals 4.
